name: c3-ide
description: C3 Studio — AI-powered IDE built on Eclipse Theia

scripts.prepare:protocol: yarn run clean:protocol && yarn workspace @c3/protocol build --force && yarn run verify:protocol-runtime
scripts.verify:protocol-runtime: node -e "const p=require('./extensions/c3-protocol'); const required=['validateM1Contract','validateCoreEventStream','classifyTerminal','encodeM1Contract','decodeM1Contract','roundTripM1Contract','isM1ContractEnvelope']; for (const key of required) { if (typeof p[key] !== 'function') throw new Error('Missing generated M1 protocol export: '+key); } if (p.M1_CONTRACT_VERSION !== 1) throw new Error('Unexpected generated M1 protocol version');"
scripts.clean: yarn run clean:protocol && yarn --cwd applications/electron clean
